sections.title: Overview
sections.body: The Launchpad is your home screen in {app_name}. It uses a three-zone layout: a brand band with persona greeting + date / cycle indicator at the top, a Pending Actions panel in the middle, and a role-aware tile grid at the bottom. The content adapts to your role — controllers see pending approvals and pipeline health, project leads see forecast deadlines and CR status, cost centre owners see resource confirmation queues, and executives see portfolio rollups. The full step-by-step walks for each persona live in `docs/workflows/01-launchpad-by-persona.md`.

sections.title: Tile counts by persona
sections.body:
Each persona sees a different tile grid sized to their workflow:
- **Controller (Anna Meier)** — 9 tiles: Portfolio KPIs, Pipeline, Budget vs Cutoff, Reporting, Forecast Cycle, Pending Reviews, Capacity Overview, Scenario Activity, Admin.
- **Project Lead (Priya Sharma)** — 7 tiles: My Projects, My Budget, My Progress, My Forecast, Recent Changes, Scenario Explorer, Resource Availability.
- **Cost Centre Owner (Thomas Brenner)** — 8 tiles: Team Utilization, Open Requests, Headcount, CC Budget, Portfolio, My CC's Projects, Published Scenarios, CC Simulator.
- **Executive (Dr. Klaus Weber)** — 7 tiles: Portfolio KPIs, Investment Mix, Pipeline Health, Top Risks, Scenario Activity, Budget Trajectory, Backlog.

Tile clicks are pure navigation — they never trigger state mutations directly.

sections.title: Notifications & Alerts
sections.body: The top section displays role-aware alerts. **Controllers** see pending change requests awaiting approval and new project submissions in the intake queue. **Cost Centre Owners** see incoming resource requests and CR-linked confirmations (the final stage of the CR workflow). **Project Leads** see forecast review deadlines, CR approval notifications, and sent-back CRs requiring action (with controller feedback). **Executives** see portfolio health summaries and published scenarios. Click any notification to navigate directly to the relevant screen.

sections.title: Pending Actions
sections.body: Below the brand band, the Pending Actions panel lists specific workflow items that require your attention. Each action shows a title, summary, and chevron. **Urgent items** are highlighted with a red bar on the left edge so you can prioritize them at a glance. The panel header also shows a count of total + urgent items (e.g., 'Pending Actions · 9 · 1 urgent').\n\nClicking any action deep-links directly to the relevant module, tab, and entity — for example, clicking a pending CR approval navigates to Portfolio Overview > CR Approvals with that specific CR selected. When all actions are resolved, the panel shows an 'All caught up' message. The panel can be collapsed via the **Hide** button on the right.

sections.title: Module Tiles
sections.body: The bottom section shows module cards ordered by relevance to your role. Each tile displays the module name, a metric (e.g. 'Portfolio KPIs · €3.410.650,00'), and a sub-line ('11 active · drift +6.1%'). Click a tile to open that module full-screen. Modules you don't have access to are hidden. The **Reporting** tile (controller / executive) provides access to five standard reports, the **Report Builder** (OLAP-style custom report composition), and the **AI Report Builder** (natural language report generation). Project Leads have a personalised set focused on their own projects — see the per-persona walks in `docs/workflows/01-launchpad-by-persona.md`.

sections.title: Submit New Project
sections.body: Project Leads can create a new project draft via the **+ New** button in the Workbench's project list panel, or via the Backlog page's **+ New** action. The system auto-calculates estimated costs from blended hourly rates. Once submitted via the 5-phase project intake wizard, the proposal appears in the Cost Centre Owner's resource confirmation queue, then in the Controller's intake queue.

sections.title: Role Switcher
sections.body: The role switcher dropdown in the top-right corner of the TopBar lets you switch between the four demo personas: Anna Meier (IT Controller), Thomas Brenner (Cost Centre Owner), Priya Sharma (Senior Project Lead), Dr. Klaus Weber (VP IT Strategy & Governance). Each persona has different module access, data visibility, and write permissions. Switching roles immediately updates all views to reflect that role's perspective; the chosen persona persists across browser sessions via localstorage.

sections.title: Dark Mode Toggle
sections.body: Next to the role switcher in the top-right corner, the **Sun/Moon** icon button lets you switch between display themes. Click it to toggle between **Light** (sun icon) and **Dark** (moon icon). The selected theme applies immediately across all modules, charts, dialogs, and data visualizations. Your preference is saved to the browser and persists across sessions. A hidden 'system' mode (which follows your OS preference) can also be set programmatically by writing 'system' to the `theme` localstorage key.
